summary: Full regression reached every declared suite and every detected test failure was revalidated successfully after repair.
findings: The baseline ran 33,503 application tests and Chromium ran 579 tests across all three projects. Focused reruns account for all observed failing cases. Tooling passed 194 and inventory passed 130 with 100% coverage.
Scoped core branches measured 97.15% in Calc address formatting and 93.33% in Writer header/footer initialization.
residual_risks: The application-wide 100% coverage gate failed on the complete baseline. The recorded 97.05% line and 94.15% branch coverage do not constitute a green global coverage status.
